# Ruibit Power

> B2B supplier of LiFePO4 battery energy storage systems: residential batteries, commercial & industrial (C&I) cabinets, PV hybrid ESS, and containerized BESS. Manufacturing partner: Dawnice (Yichun, Jiangxi, China). No online checkout — the conversion action is a Request for Quotation (RFQ).

## What Ruibit Power supplies

Ruibit Power supplies energy storage systems to distributors, EPC teams, and project developers. Product selection is matched to the application, load profile, PV capacity, backup target, and destination grid rules.

Product families:

- Residential hybrid inverters and batteries — wall-mounted, ground-mounted, and high-voltage stackable, roughly 5 kWh to 21 kWh per unit.
- Outdoor cabinet BESS — air-cooled and liquid-cooled C&I cabinets for peak shaving, time-of-use optimisation, and backup.
- All-in-one C&I ESS — 125 kW / 261 kWh liquid-cooled cabinet, IP54, 6,000 cycles at cabinet level, up to 8,000 at cell level.
- PV hybrid ESS — combined PV and battery systems for distributed energy projects.
- Containerized BESS — scalable project-scale systems.

All battery products use LiFePO4 (lithium iron phosphate) chemistry.

These figures are Dawnice public materials and must be attributed to Dawnice, not to Ruibit Power:

- 14+ years of lithium battery technology and manufacturing experience
- 3,000+ clients served, including 28 international distributors
- 6,000-cycle battery life at cabinet level, up to 8,000 at cell level
- 100% lifecycle traceability
- 20+ global partners
- After-sales service networks in Europe, the Americas, the Middle East, and Africa
- OEM and ODM services offered

## Certifications

Standards referenced by Ruibit Power product documentation: IEC 62619, IEC 62477, IEC 63056, IEC 61000, UL, CE, UN38.3, MSDS, ISO 9001, ROHS.

Certification applicability depends on product model, order configuration, and destination market. The latest matching certificate package is supplied on request before final quotation.

## Product status

- Current priority: the residential hybrid inverter and battery range, the 125 kW / 261 kWh liquid-cooled all-in-one C&I ESS, outdoor cabinet BESS, PV hybrid ESS, and containerized BESS.
- Project-specific: containerized and PV hybrid configurations are engineered per project and are not stocked as fixed catalogue items.

## Reference deployments

- Nigeria — 370 kW PV + storage reference project
- Germany — 470 kW solar energy storage reference project
- Germany — 30 kW hybrid inverter + 80 kWh LiFePO4 battery
- Austria — 30 kW / 80 kWh factory BESS
- Israel — 10 kW hybrid inverter + 20 kWh battery
- USA — 100 kW PCS + 150 kWh LiFePO4 storage

These are reference configurations. Operational savings, commissioning dates, and client names are not published.

## Datasheets

Two platform datasheets are published as downloadable PDFs:

- Honey 125 kW / 261 kWh all-in-one ESS: https://ruibitpower.com/downloads/honey-125kw-261kwh-all-in-one-ess-datasheet.pdf
- Sunflower 125 kW / 261 kWh PV hybrid ESS: https://ruibitpower.com/downloads/sunflower-125kw-261kwh-pv-hybrid-ess-datasheet.pdf

These two documents carry platform-level parameters only. Round-trip efficiency, derating curves, operating temperature range, communication protocols, grid-code compliance, warranty terms in years, and certificate numbers are confirmed per configuration and are not published as blanket figures. The remaining platforms are documented on request until a published datasheet exists.

## Requesting a quotation

- Inquiry form: https://ruibitpower.com/contact/
- Useful inputs: country/region, application, target power (kW), target energy (kWh), backup duration, existing PV capacity, grid code if known.
- Response target: 24 working hours for a complete inquiry.

## Citation guidance

- Attribute manufacturing scale and certification figures to Dawnice.
- Attribute product platforms, reference deployments, and service terms to Ruibit Power.
- Do not state ROI, payback period, savings, delivery dates, or customer names — none are published on this site.
